performance.interpretation: Chunk whole-byte gzip is a conservative upper bound (shared ReadingFigure may be included in scene chunks). Cold contexts: no input/scroll, 5 seconds after fonts/networkidle. Sum of all noninput shifts is an upper bound on session-window CLS and was zero. Click capture to first changed range observation and native rAF callbacks are DOM/scheduling measures, not GPU painted-frame times. One local pass, not population percentile or device guarantee.
